arxiv-1503-08345.title: Implementing an intelligent version of the classical sliding-puzzle game for unix terminals using Golang’s concurrency primitives
arxiv-1503-08345.creator: Pravendra Singh
arxiv-1503-08345.description: Abstract Abstract An intelligent version of the sliding-puzzle game is developed using the new Go programming language, which uses a concurrent version of the A^{*} Informed Search Algorithm to power solver-bot that runs in the background. The game runs in computer system’s terminals.

arxiv-1902-05493.title: Continuum theory of electrostatic correlations at charged surfaces
arxiv-1902-05493.creator: J. Pedro de Souza, Martin Z. Bazant
arxiv-1902-05493.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by J. Pedro de Souza, Martin Z. Bazant. The standard model for diffuse charge phenomena in colloid science, electrokinetics and biology is the Poisson-Boltzmann mean-field theory, which breaks down for multivalent ions and large surface charge densities due to electrostatic correlations.

arxiv-2109-04049.title: BeamTransformer: Microphone Array-based Overlapping Speech Detection
arxiv-2109-04049.creator: Siqi Zheng, Shiliang Zhang, Weilong Huang, Qian Chen, Hongbin Suo, Ming Lei, Jinwei Feng, Zhijie Yan
arxiv-2109-04049.description: Abstract We propose BeamTransformer, an efficient architecture to leverage beamformer’s edge in spatial filtering and transformer’s capability in context sequence modeling. BeamTransformer seeks to optimize modeling of sequential relationship among signals from different spatial direction. Overlapping speech detection is one of the tasks where such optimization is favorable. In this paper we effectively apply BeamTransformer to detect overlapping segments.

arxiv-2207-12542.title: A Randomized Algorithm for Tensor Singular Value Decomposition Using an Arbitrary Number of Passes Journal: Journal of Scientific Computing
arxiv-2207-12542.creator: Salman Ahmadi-Asl, Anh-Huy Phan, Andrzej Cichocki
arxiv-2207-12542.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Salman Ahmadi-Asl, Anh-Huy Phan, Andrzej Cichocki. Efficient and fast computation of a tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) with a few passes over the underlying data tensor is crucial because of its many potential applications. The current/existing subspace randomized algorithms need ( 2 ​ q + 2 ) (2q+2) passes over the data tensor to compute a t-SVD, where q q is a non-negative integer number (power iteration parameter).

arxiv-2303-05543.title: Advanced Techniques in Automated High Resolution Scanning Transmission Electron Microscopy
arxiv-2303-05543.creator: Alexander J. Pattison, Cassio C.S. Pedroso, Bruce E. Cohen, Justin C. Ondry, A. Paul Alivisatos, Wolfgang Theis, Peter Ercius
arxiv-2303-05543.description: Abstract Scanning transmission electron microscopy is a common tool used to study the atomic structure of materials. It is an inherently multimodal tool allowing for the simultaneous acquisition of multiple information channels. Despite its versatility, however, experimental workflows currently rely heavily on experienced human operators and can only acquire data from small regions of a sample at a time.

arxiv-2306-11266.title: Crossover from Cooper-pair hopping to single-electron hopping in Pb x (TiO 2 ) 1-x granular films
arxiv-2306-11266.creator: Zhi-Hao He, Zi-Yan Han, Kuang-Hong Gao, Zi-Wu Wang, Zhi-Qing Li
arxiv-2306-11266.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhi-Hao He, Zi-Yan Han, Kuang-Hong Gao, Zi-Wu Wang, Zhi-Qing Li. The electrical transport properties of Pb x (TiO 2 ) 1-x ( x x being the Pb volume fraction and ranging from ∼ \sim 0.45 to ∼ \sim 0.69) granular films are investigated experimentally. The charging energy of the Pb granules is reduced to less than the superconducting gap of Pb granules for the low temperature insulating films by using high- k k dielectric TiO 2 as the insulating matrix.

arxiv-2405-01241.title: Port-Hamiltonian systems with energy and power ports footnoteinfo
arxiv-2405-01241.creator: Kaja Krhač, Bernhard Maschke, Arjan van der Schaft
arxiv-2405-01241.description: Abstract We extend the port-Hamiltonian framework defined with respect to a Lagrangian submanifold and a Dirac structure by augmenting the Lagrangian submanifold with the space of external variables. The new pair of conjugated variables is called energy port. We show that in the most general case, the extension describes constrained Hamiltonian systems whose Hamiltonian function depends on inputs.

arxiv-2504-08516.title: Lift force in chiral, compressible granular matter
arxiv-2504-08516.creator: Jarosław Pawłowski, Marcin Dudziak, Matteo Baggioli, Jie Zhang, Piotr Surówka
arxiv-2504-08516.description: Abstract Micropolar fluid theory, an extension of classical Newtonian fluid dynamics, incorporates angular velocities and rotational inertias and has long been a foundational framework for describing granular flows. We propose a macroscopic model of granular matter based on micropolar fluid dynamics, which incorporates internal rotations, couple stresses, and broken parity through odd viscosity.

arxiv-2505-15869.title: Quantum steganographic protocols using degenerate and entanglement-assisted quantum codes
arxiv-2505-15869.creator: Sanjoy Dutta, Nihar Ranjan Dash, Subhashish Banerjee, R. Srikanth
arxiv-2505-15869.description: Abstract Steganography is the art of concealing secret information by embedding it in an apparently innocent-looking message. Quantum steganography applies the principles of quantum mechanics to traditional steganography and, compared to the latter, offers significant advantages, including heightened security, improved concealment, and increased data-hiding capacity.

pmc-10671609.creator: Selladurai Manivannan, Bhadriraju Subramanyam, Deanna S Scheff
pmc-10671609.description: Simple SummaryIn recent years, there has been a resurgence of interest in silica-based powders as a non-chemical alternative for safeguarding stored food grains from stored product insects. Previous research has indicated that the red flour beetle, Tribolium castaneum (Herbst) (Coleoptera: Tenebrionidae), displays a higher tolerance to inert dusts.

pmc-13224693.title: The complete chloroplast genome sequence and phylogenetic analysis of Hydrocleys nymphoides (Alismataceae), an aquatic ornamental plant
pmc-13224693.creator: Xiuli Lu, Wei Ming
pmc-13224693.description: The complete chloroplast (cp) genome of Hydrocleys nymphoides, an aquatic ornamental plant, was sequenced and assembled in this study. The circular genome was 187,253 bp in length and exhibited a typical quadripartite structure of the large single-copy (LSC, 94,246 bp) and small single-copy (SSC, 483 bp) regions, separated by a pair of inverted repeats (IRs, 46,262 bp).

pmc-13333100.title: Burden and Outcomes of Acute Kidney Injury in Critically Ill Patients
pmc-13333100.creator: Anakath M Ijas, Gayathry Rajasekharan, Chinthu Sara Jacob, Vijayakumar Anil, Rajasekharan Chandrasekharan
pmc-13333100.description: IntroductionAcute kidney injury (AKI) represents a frequent and serious complication among patients requiring intensive care. This syndrome is a primary driver of elevated morbidity and mortality, while also leading to extended hospital stays and an increased susceptibility to future chronic kidney disease (CKD).
